back: Training and validation error both high and close. Fix: richer model / better features.
Training error low, validation error much higher. Fix: more data, regularisation, simpler model.

front: Role of train / validation / test sets
back: Train: fit weights. Validation: choose settings. Test: report once at the end.
Split into $k$ folds; train on $k-1$, validate on the held-out fold; average the $k$ errors. Each point validates exactly once.

front: Does training error fall with model complexity?
back: Always (for nested models). Validation error is U-shaped.
Using information from validation/test data when fitting anything (scalers, feature selection, hyper-parameters). Do everything inside the training fold.

front: Does more data fix high bias?
back: No. More data lowers variance; high bias needs a more expressive model.
$\sigma^2$, the noise in the targets: no model can go below it.
Train on the past, validate on a later period; never shuffle across time.
Pick the simplest model whose CV error is within one standard error of the best.
